title: Developer Utilities Module
summary: This module provides command-line utilities for managing package versions, creating Git tags and releases, and automating documentation generation and translation based on code changes. It streamlines release processes and ensures documentation consistency.

nodes.label: Developer
nodes.title: Developer Interaction
nodes.description: The human user who initiates versioning and documentation commands.

nodes.label: Git Repository
nodes.title: Version Control System
nodes.description: The local Git repository where code changes and version files are managed.

nodes.label: GitHub Platform
nodes.title: Remote Git Hosting & CI/CD
nodes.description: The remote GitHub platform used for pull requests, branch management, and release creation.

nodes.label: OpenAI API
nodes.title: AI Content Generation & Translation
nodes.description: An external AI service used for analyzing code diffs, generating new documentation content, and translating existing documentation.

nodes.label: Bump Package Versions
nodes.title: cli.bump
nodes.description: Updates version strings across all packages in the 'lib/' directory to a specified new version. Handles file modifications and prepares for Git operations.

nodes.label: Manage Git Branches
nodes.title: cli.bump (internal)
nodes.description: Creates or resets a Git branch for version bump changes, ensuring a clean state for commits and pull requests.

nodes.label: Commit & Push Changes
nodes.title: cli.bump (internal)
nodes.description: Commits the version bump changes to the local Git repository and pushes the new branch to the remote GitHub repository.

nodes.label: Create GitHub Pull Request
nodes.title: cli.bump (internal)
nodes.description: Generates a new pull request on GitHub for the version bump changes, facilitating code review and merging.

nodes.label: Create Version Tag & Release
nodes.title: cli.tag
nodes.description: Creates a Git tag and a corresponding GitHub release based on the detected package version. Ensures the main branch is up-to-date before tagging.

nodes.label: Analyze Code Changes for Docs
nodes.title: docs_check.docs_check
nodes.description: Compares the current branch with a base branch to identify code changes and determines if new or updated documentation is required.

nodes.label: Generate New Documentation
nodes.title: docs_check.docs_check (internal)
nodes.description: Creates new English documentation files based on the analysis of code changes, leveraging AI for content generation.

nodes.label: Update Existing Documentation
nodes.title: docs_check.docs_check (internal)
nodes.description: Modifies existing English documentation files to reflect code updates, using AI to integrate changes seamlessly.

nodes.label: Translate Documentation
nodes.title: docs_check.docs_check (internal)
nodes.description: Translates generated or updated English documentation into multiple supported languages using an AI service.

nodes.label: Local Documentation Files
nodes.title: Documentation Storage
nodes.description: The local directory where English and translated documentation files are stored and managed.

groups.label: Documentation Automation
groups.title: Automated Documentation Generation

groups.label: External Dependencies

groups.description: Represents external systems that the developer utilities interact with, including Git for version control, GitHub for remote repository management, and OpenAI for AI-powered tasks.

groups.title: Local Data Storage
groups.description: Represents the local file system where documentation files are stored and managed.
